description: E-Ladestationen (WFS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal-ludwigsfelde.de. Representation of locations of e-charging stations in the urban area of Ludwigsfelde. E-charging stations not operated by the city are included for information (data basis here: The used signatures of the working group XErleben are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License (. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "E-charging stations (WFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include infoFeatureAccessService, E-Tankstellen, Stadt Ludwigsfelde. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
